about.title: About Me
about.content: Ali Sabawi is an Iraqi technology expert and digital content creator from Mosul (born 1998). He specializes in computer systems, information technology, cybersecurity, digital solutions, and social media platforms. He serves as the Executive Director of Al-Hayat Center in Iraq and provides specialized services for TikTok LIVE content creators and digital solutions. He manages channels and accounts for celebrities and artists on YouTube, Facebook, and TikTok. He publishes technical content on account security, solving platform monetization and tax issues, account recovery, and technical troubleshooting.
